name: Paperclip
author: Sceny
description: Paperclip AI in the Omarchy bar: what your agents are doing, what is waiting for you, and a setup that keeps the instance running.

barWidget.description: One paperclip in the bar for your Paperclip instance: it turns urgent when something needs you, carries a light while agents work, and opens a panel to open, start or repair it.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: Needs-me: something waits on you, a run failed, or the instance died. Everything: also when the instance starts and agents pick up work. Notifications live in Omarchy's notification centre, which is where their history is.

schema.label: Rows the panel lists
schema.description: Needs-me: the open inbox, which reaches zero when you clear it. All: also what you snoozed or cleared, so a row cleared by mistake is findable. The bar bubble always counts the rows this filter lists.

schema.label: Try again: rows per press
schema.description: Retry all works through this many failed runs per press, one at a time. The rest stay in the list for the next press.

schema.label: Keep Paperclip running
schema.description: Start the background service again when the instance is found down (at most once every ten minutes).

schema.label: Show the count in the bubble
schema.description: Off keeps the bubble but drops the number.

schema.label: Animations
schema.description: Off keeps the same layout and colors and only removes the movement: the panel's fade-in, the travelling light on the icon and the pulse on the bubble.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: The open panel refreshes at least every 10 seconds.

schema.label: Instance id
schema.description: Leave empty for the default local instance.

schema.label: API base URL
schema.description: Leave empty to read the URL from the instance's runtime-info.json.
